a: Food webs show interconnected feeding relationships.
Trophic levels classify organisms by feeding position.
Keystone species have outsized effects on community structure.
Invasive species can disrupt ecosystems they enter.
Resources and conditions set carrying capacity.
Adaptation is heritable trait change; acclimation is individual adjustment.
Conservation aims to protect species and habitats.
Roughly: CO2 + H2O + light → sugars + O2.
Cellular respiration oxidizes sugars to release ATP, CO2, and water.
DNA replication is semiconservative: each new helix keeps one old strand.
